name: member-statement
title: Member statement: draft
for_each: select id,name from members order by name

sections.title: Membership
sections.sql: select name,email,status,joined_on,renewal_due from members where id=$1

sections.title: Invoices and balance
sections.sql: select name,amount,currency,balance,due_on,void from invoice_balances where member_id=$1 order by due_on
sections.note: Recorded receipts only. Review against your bank and accounts before issuing.

name: event-roll
title: Event attendance roll: draft
for_each: select id,name from events order by starts_on

sections.title: Event
sections.sql: select name,starts_on,venue,capacity,status from events where id=$1

sections.title: Attendees
sections.sql: select m.name,r.status from registrations r join members m on m.id=r.member_id where event_id=$1 order by m.name

name: renewal-letter
title: Membership renewal: draft
for_each: select id,name from members where status in ('active','lapsed') and renewal_due<=current_date+60

sections.title: Renewal details
sections.sql: select m.name,m.renewal_due,l.name as membership,l.annual_fee,l.currency from members m left join levels l on l.id=m.level_id where m.id=$1
sections.note: Please review your renewal details with our team. This draft is not a receipt or payment instruction.

name: governance-notice
title: Committee notice: draft
for_each: select id,name from obligations where completed_on is null

sections.title: Notice details
sections.note: Review the constitution, recipient list and notice period before sending. This file does not send a notice.
